articles.title: Crypto’s billions are back, but the premiums aren’t
articles.description: Kalshi seeks a $40 billion valuation, while Blockchain.com targets an IPO and crypto treasury companies struggle to maintain their once-high valuations.

articles.title: Bitcoin briefly hits $87K as weak US jobs data sends bond yields lower
articles.description: Bitcoin climbed after weaker-than-expected payrolls pushed Treasury yields lower, but order-book resistance kept BTC from reaching new macro highs.

articles.title: ‘Euro stablecoin isn’t enough’: EU issuers make case for USD tokens
articles.description: European issuers say Europe cannot ignore demand for dollar stablecoins as businesses seek USD liquidity for global payments and settlement.

articles.title: Furious debate about THORChain vs NEAR shows idealism has limits
articles.description: The furious debate over Bitget’s $387.7M of hacked funds comes down to whether ideals around “permissionless and decentralized” tech means never intervening — even if you could.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Circle urges EU to revise stablecoin reserve rules in MiCA review
articles.description: Circle wants the EU to replace mandatory bank-deposit minimums with more flexible liquidity rules and preserve cross-border stablecoin issuance.

articles.title: BNB Chain crosses $1B in tokenized stocks, ETFs as market hits $3.7B
articles.description: Tokenized stocks and ETFs on BNB Chain reached $1.1 billion as the broader market climbed to $3.7 billion, putting the network’s share at roughly 30%.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasuries may struggle to match Strategy, says Ammous
articles.description: Strategy’s scale and cash reserves give it an edge over treasury rivals, according to Saifedean Ammous, author of “The Bitcoin Standard.”

articles.title: CONNECT recap: Arthur Hayes on money printing, Wall Street moves onchain
articles.description: Arthur Hayes said money printing could lift crypto prices, while CONNECT Seoul speakers examined Wall Street’s competitive edge onchain.

articles.title: Bitcoin reaches for $87K as short liquidations top $120M
articles.description: Bitcoin buyers broke through a wall of ask liquidity to reach new October BTC price highs near $87,800, with the area immediately above now a new resistance hurdle.

articles.title: Aave founder says V3 unaffected after third-party adapter exploit drains $305K
articles.description: Aave founder Stani Kulechov said Aave v3 was unaffected after an attacker exploited a third-party adapter to drain about $305,000 from two Safe multisig wallets.

articles.title: Porsche’s ‘long haul’ Web3 project ends in less than four years
articles.description: Porsche is winding down its Web3 project and Pioneers Circle community as trading activity in its 911 NFT collection falls sharply from early levels.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs kick off ‘Uptober’ with $103M inflow
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs returned to inflows with $103 million, while Ether funds recorded a third straight day of net outflows.

articles.title: South Korea crypto exchange profits fall 78% in H1 amid trading slump
articles.description: South Korean crypto exchange operating profits fell 78% in the first half of 2026 as trading volumes, market capitalization and customer deposits declined.

articles.title: South Korea advances tokenized securities rules ahead of 2027 rollout
articles.description: South Korea’s financial regulator proposed detailed rules for tokenized securities, including capital requirements, OTC trading licenses and retail investment limits.

articles.title: Zano exploiter minted more than a quadrillion fUSD before blockchain rollback
articles.description: The unauthorized coins were indistinguishable from legitimate ZANO, leaving the team unable to remove them without rolling back the blockchain.

articles.title: Core Lightning warns attackers are targeting unpatched nodes
articles.description: Node operators running version 26.06.7 or earlier were told to upgrade immediately.

articles.title: Ethereum’s zkAPI brings privacy-preserving API payments to mainnet
articles.description: Ethereum’s zkAPI is now live on mainnet, turning an earlier zero-knowledge API payment proposal into a working implementation for private, prepaid access.

articles.title: NEAR Intents says it’s identified the hacker, gives 48-hour ultimatum
articles.description: “We have identified you, sir,” NEAR Intents general manager Alex Shevchenko said on Friday after the protocol was hacked for $3.8 million.

articles.title: SEC moves to clear custody hurdle for advisers offering crypto
articles.description: Custody requirements have kept some investment advisers from offering certain crypto to clients, a regulatory hurdle the SEC’s proposal could remove.

articles.title: China warns foreign spies about crypto, Singapore dominates Asia: Asia Express
articles.description: Singapore’s crypto economy grows 55%, South Korea set to make crypto market makers legal, and Chinese spy ministry warns would-be foreign spies it’s watching the blockchain.

articles.title: Evernorth clears shareholder vote ahead of Nasdaq debut with 473M XRP treasury
articles.description: Evernorth expects to begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker XRPN after its SPAC merger closes, with an XRP treasury worth roughly $710 million at current prices.

articles.title: Trump to host 3rd ‘exclusive’ memecoin event amid corruption claims
articles.description: The president is scheduled to appear at his golf club in Washington, DC, at a Nov. 22 dinner for his top 185 memecoin holders, following similar events in May 2025 and April 2026.

articles.title: 50,000 Europeans call on EU to ease stablecoin rewards restrictions in MiCA review
articles.description: A 50,000-letter campaign is pressing Brussels to rethink stablecoin rewards as EU central banks seek broader changes to MiCA’s stablecoin rules.

articles.title: Illinois will postpone implementation of crypto tax following lawsuit
articles.description: State officials agreed to delay the 0.2% crypto tax for six months after lawsuits and industry pushback claimed the bill was rushed through the legislature.

articles.title: New York, Wyoming regulators sign pact to coordinate crypto oversight
articles.description: The agreement will allow the two state regulators to share supervisory information, streamline licensing reviews and coordinate examinations and enforcement actions involving digital asset firms.

articles.title: Bitcoin fights for local uptrend as US bond yields drop from new 24-year highs
articles.description: US bond yields fell sharply around Thursday’s Wall Street open as Bitcoin price action sought to preserve a local trend of higher lows.

articles.title: NEAR Intents suffers $3.8M exploit after assistance with Bitget breach
articles.description: The platform said it will compensate users affected by the hack, which stemmed from a bug that affected deposits and withdrawals.

articles.title: Bitget’s $388M hack pushes Q3 crypto security losses past $1B
articles.description: Crypto security losses reached $1.26 billion in Q3 across 247 incidents, with September alone accounting for roughly $769 million.

articles.title: LATAM stablecoin liquidity may depend on few providers, investor says
articles.description: Researchers in a Latin American stablecoin ecosystem report warned “fragility in the system is concentrated in its thinnest layer,” with just 16 of 494 companies focused primarily on wholesale liquidity, treasury and credit.
